me/n.xml:
<entryFree id="n66260"
                       key="me/n"
                       type="main"
                       opt="n"
                       TEIform="entryFree">
               <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="orth">me/n</orth>, Particle, used partly to express certainty on the part of the speaker or writer; partly, and more commonly, to point out that the word or clause with which it stands is correlative to another word or clause that is to follow, the latter word or clause being introduced by <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">de/</foreign>. <sense n="A" id="n66260.0" level="1" opt="n" TEIform="sense"> </sense>
               <sense n="I" id="n66260.1" level="2" opt="n" TEIform="sense"> 
                  <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">me/n</foreign> used absolutely to express certainty, not followed by correlative <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">de/</foreign>, <tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">indeed, of a truth</tr>, synonymous with <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">mh/n</foreign>, as appears from the <gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
                     <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Ep.</gram>
                  </gramGrp> and <gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
                     <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Ion.</gram>
                  </gramGrp> form <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">h)= me/n</foreign> in protestations and oaths (where <gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
                     <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Att.</gram>
                  </gramGrp> used <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">h)= mh/n</foreign>)<cit TEIform="cit">
                     <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">, kai/ moi o)/mosson, h)= m. moi pro/frwn e)/pesin kai\ xersi\n a)rh/cein</quote> 
                     <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1:77"
                           default="NO"
                           TEIform="bibl">
                        <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
                        <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.77</biblScope>
                     </bibl>
                  </cit>, cf. <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:14:275"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">14.275</biblScope>
                  </bibl>; <cit TEIform="cit">
                     <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">h)= me/n toi ta/de pa/nta telei/etai</quote> 
                     <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg002.perseus-grc1:14:160"
                           default="NO"
                           TEIform="bibl">
                        <author TEIform="author">Od.</author>
                        <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">14.160</biblScope>
                     </bibl>
                  </cit>, cf. <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:24:416"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">24.416</biblScope>
                  </bibl>; <cit TEIform="cit">
                     <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">tou=ton e)corkoi=, h)= me/n oi( dihkonh/sein</quote> 
                     <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0016.tlg001.perseus-grc1:4:154"
                           default="NO"
                           TEIform="bibl">
                        <author TEIform="author">Hdt.</author>
                        <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4.154</biblScope>
                     </bibl>
                  </cit>, cf. <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0016.tlg001.perseus-grc1:5:93"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">5.93</biblScope>
                  </bibl>, etc.: with neg., <cit TEIform="cit">
                     <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">ou) me\n ga/r ti kako\n basileue/men</quote> 
                     <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg002.perseus-grc1:1:392"
                           default="NO"
                           TEIform="bibl">
                        <author TEIform="author">Od.</author>
                        <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.392</biblScope>
                     </bibl>
                  </cit>, etc.; <cit TEIform="cit">
                     <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">w)/mosa, mh\ me\n . . a)nafh=nai</quote> 
                     <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg002.perseus-grc1:4:254"
                           default="NO"
                           TEIform="bibl">
                        <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4.254</biblScope>
                     </bibl>
                  </cit>, cf. <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0016.tlg001.perseus-grc1:2:118"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <author TEIform="author">Hdt.</author>
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2.118</biblScope>
                  </bibl>, <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0016.tlg001.perseus-grc1:179"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">179</biblScope>
                  </bibl>; <cit TEIform="cit">
                     <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">e)/carnos h)=n, mh\ me\n a)poktei=nai</quote> 
                     <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0016.tlg001.perseus-grc1:3:67"
                           default="NO"
                           TEIform="bibl">
                        <author TEIform="author">Id.</author>
                        <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">3.67</biblScope>
                     </bibl>
                  </cit>, cf. <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0016.tlg001.perseus-grc1:99"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">99</biblScope>
                  </bibl>: without neg., <cit TEIform="cit">
                     <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">a)ndro\s me\n to/de sh=ma pa/lai katateqnhw=tos</quote> 
                     <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:7:89"
                           default="NO"
                           TEIform="bibl">
                        <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
                        <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">7.89</biblScope>
                     </bibl>
                  </cit>: also in Trag., <cit TEIform="cit">
                     <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">a)kth\ me\n h(/de th=s perirru/tou xqono/s</quote> 
                     <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg006.perseus-grc1:1"
                           default="NO"
                           TEIform="bibl">
                        <author TEIform="author">S.</author>
                        <title TEIform="title">Ph.</title>
                        <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1</biblScope>
                     </bibl>
                  </cit>, cf. <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg006.perseus-grc1:159"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">159</biblScope>
                  </bibl> (anap.), <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg007.perseus-grc1:44"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <title TEIform="title">OC</title>
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">44</biblScope>
                  </bibl>, <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0006.tlg003.perseus-grc1:676"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <author TEIform="author">E.</author>
                     <title TEIform="title">Med.</title>
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">676</biblScope>
                  </bibl>, <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0006.tlg003.perseus-grc1:1129"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1129</biblScope>
                  </bibl>, etc.; <cit TEIform="cit">
                     <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">kai\ me/n</quote> 
                     <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1:269"
                           default="NO"
                           TEIform="bibl">
                        <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
                        <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.269</biblScope>
                     </bibl>
                  </cit>, <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:9:632"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">9.632</biblScope>
                  </bibl>, etc.; <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ou)de\ me\n ou)de\</foreign> . . <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:2:703"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2.703</biblScope>
                  </bibl>, <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:12:212"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">12.212</biblScope>
                  </bibl>; <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ge me/n</foreign>, cf. <itype lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="itype">ge</itype> 
                  <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1:5"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.5</biblScope>
                  </bibl>. </sense>
               <sense n="2" id="n66260.2" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense"> an answering clause with <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">de/</foreign> is sts. implied, <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">th\n me\n e)gw\ spoudh=| da/mnhm' e)pe/essi</foreign> her can I hardly subdue, [<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">but</tr> all others easily], <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:5:893"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">5.893</biblScope>
                  </bibl>; <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">w(s me\n le/gousi</foreign> as <tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">indeed</tr> they say, [<tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">but</tr> as I believe not], <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0006.tlg016.perseus-grc1:8"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <author TEIform="author">E.</author>
                     <title TEIform="title">Or.</title> 
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">8</biblScope>
                  </bibl>; <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">kai\ prw=ton me\n h)=n au)tw=| po/lemos</foreign> (with no <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">e)/peita de/</foreign> to follow), <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0032.tlg006.perseus-grc1:1:9:14"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <author TEIform="author">X.</author> 
                     <title TEIform="title">An.</title>
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.9.14</biblScope>
                  </bibl>; so <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">nu=n me/n s' a)fh/sw</foreign> I will let you go <tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">this time</tr>, <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0650.tlg001:5:81"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <author TEIform="author">Herod.</author>
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">5.81</biblScope>
                  </bibl>: to give force to assertions made by a person respecting himself

mh/n1.xml:
<entryFree id="n67461"
                       key="mh/n1"
                       type="main"
                       opt="n"
                       TEIform="entryFree">
               <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="orth">mh/n</orth>, <gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
                  <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Dor.</gram>
               </gramGrp> (<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0521.tlg001:78" default="NO" TEIform="bibl">
                  <author TEIform="author">Epich.</author>
                  <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">78</biblScope>
               </bibl>, etc.), <gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
                  <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Aeol.</gram>
               </gramGrp> (<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0009.tlg001:23:5"
                     default="NO"
                     TEIform="bibl">
                  <author TEIform="author">Sapph.</author>
                  <title TEIform="title">Supp.</title>
                  <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">23.5</biblScope>
               </bibl>, etc.), and old <gramGrp opt="n" TEIform="gramGrp">
                  <gram type="dialect" opt="n" TEIform="gram">Ep.</gram>
               </gramGrp> 
               <orth extent="full" lang="greek" opt="n" TEIform="orth">ma/n</orth> (in Hom.always folld. by a vowel exc. <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:5:895"
                     default="NO"
                     TEIform="bibl">
                  <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
                  <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">5.895</biblScope>
               </bibl>,<bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:765"
                     default="NO"
                     TEIform="bibl">
                  <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">765</biblScope>
               </bibl>, whereas <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">mh/n</foreign> is folld. by a consonant exc. in <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:19:45"
                     default="NO"
                     TEIform="bibl">
                  <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
                  <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">19.45</biblScope>
               </bibl>; original <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">ma/n</foreign> has prob. been changed to <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">me/n</foreign> exc. when the metre prevented), a Particle used to strengthen asseverations, <sense id="n67461.0" n="A" level="1" opt="n" TEIform="sense">
                  <tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">verily, truly</tr>; a synonym of <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">me/n</foreign> but stronger, and <abbr TEIform="abbr">like</abbr>  it always following the word which begins the clause, <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">w(=de ga\r e)cere/w, kai\ m. tetelesme/non e)/stai</foreign> and so <tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">verily</tr> . . , <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:23:410"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">23.410</biblScope>
                  </bibl>; <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">i)/ste ma\n</foreign> . . ye know <tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">doubtless</tr>, <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0033.tlg004.perseus-grc1:4(3).35"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <author TEIform="author">Pi.</author>
                     <title TEIform="title">I.</title>
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">4(3).35</biblScope>
                  </bibl>: freq. with imper., <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">a)/ge m.</foreign> on <tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">then</tr>, <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:1:302"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">1.302</biblScope>
                  </bibl>; <cit TEIform="cit">
                     <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">a)/grei ma/n</quote> 
                     <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:5:765"
                           default="NO"
                           TEIform="bibl">
                        <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">5.765</biblScope>
                     </bibl>
                  </cit>; <cit TEIform="cit">
                     <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">a)/nage ma/n</quote> 
                     <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0085.tlg006.perseus-grc1:963"
                           default="NO"
                           TEIform="bibl">
                        <author TEIform="author">A.</author>
                        <title TEIform="title">Ch.</title>
                        <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">963</biblScope>
                     </bibl>
                  </cit> (lyr.); <cit TEIform="cit">
                     <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">e(/peo ma/n</quote> 
                     <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0011.tlg007.perseus-grc1:182"
                           default="NO"
                           TEIform="bibl">
                        <author TEIform="author">S.</author>
                        <title TEIform="title">OC</title>
                        <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">182</biblScope>
                     </bibl>
                  </cit> (lyr.). </sense>
               <sense n="II" id="n67461.1" level="2" opt="n" TEIform="sense"> after other Particles, </sense>
               <sense n="1" id="n67461.2" level="3" opt="n" TEIform="sense"> 
                  <foreign lang="greek" TEIform="foreign">h)= mh/n</foreign>, <tr opt="n" TEIform="tr">now verily, full surely</tr>, <cit TEIform="cit">
                     <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">h)= mh\n kai\ po/nos e)sti/n</quote> 
                     <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:2:291"
                           default="NO"
                           TEIform="bibl">
                        <author TEIform="author">Il.</author>
                        <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">2.291</biblScope>
                     </bibl>
                  </cit>, cf. <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0013.tlg003.perseus-grc1:87"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <title TEIform="title">h.Ap.</title>
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">87</biblScope>
                  </bibl>, <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0020.tlg003.perseus-grc1:101"
                        default="NO"
                        TEIform="bibl">
                     <author TEIform="author">Hes.</author> 
                     <title TEIform="title">Sc.</title>
                     <biblScope TEIform="biblScope">101</biblScope>
                  </bibl>; <cit TEIform="cit">
                     <quote lang="greek" TEIform="quote">h)= ma/n</quote> 
                     <bibl n="urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0012.tlg001.perseus-grc1:2:370"
                           default="NO"
